|rad2oui = |rad2_ant_conn = MHF4 |rad2txchains = 4 |rad2rxchains = 4 |rad2sstreams = 4 |rad2stand = IEEE 802.11a/n/ac |acqam2 = |rad2ac = 1733 |rad2n = 300 |rad2a = 54 |rad2freq = 5 }}{{TIDTOC|embedded}} ==Overview== :Also known as the '''[[Arris TR4400-AC]]''' and includes the '''SAC2V1A''' 1GB RAM variant. The Arris TR4400 v2 is a dual band router provided by Spectrum to customers as the "Wave 2" with model number RAC2V1A. It uses a Qualcomm IPQ8065 SoC with 512 MB RAM and 256 MB NAND flash. There is also a SAC2V1A model [https://www.spectrum.net/en/support/internet/spectrum-wave-2-router-user-manual variant] for the same FCCID and WiFi Alliance [https://www.wi-fi.org/product-finder-results?keywords=WFA71730 certification] (WFA71730) but with 1 GB RAM. RAC2V1A [https://github.com/Lanchon/tr4400-v2-stock-firmware/tree/master OEM firmware] uses OpenWrt Barrier Breaker r1121 build (other reported builds: 1418, 1602, 1782, 1806). The default radio SSID's are ''MySpectrumWifi{last 2 MAC characters}-2G'' and ''-5G''. The SAC2V1A is based on Chaos Calmer 15.05.1 (r35193) and the back label references a QR code to use the Spectrum app for setup. The default radio SSID nomenclature changes to ''SpectrumSetup-{last 2 MAC characters}'' and OpenWrt installation is the same for the hardware and SSH access, but requires different steps using the serial port. It does not currently support DSA (post-23.05 releases) and support of the full 1GB RAM requires a custom OpenWrt build. *{{WiFiCert|WFA71730|05/09/2017}} DFS support was added with an FCC Class II Permissive Change request on 12/20/2017. {{FCC ST|02/20/2018|indexme.}} ==Flashing== {{Flashnotice}} ===Flashing OpenWrt=== {{OpenWrt |techdata = https://openwrt.org/toh/hwdata/arris/arris_tr4400_v2 |wikipage = https://openwrt.org/inbox/toh/arris/tr4400_v2 |forumpage = https://forum.openwrt.org/t/arris-tr4400-v2-rac2v1a-support/122585 |github = |target = ipq806x |subtarget = generic |arch = arm_cortex-a15_neon-vfpv4 |support_commit_id = f8b0010dfb548469686049f85076fd6a3a6bca2e |support_started_version = 22.03.0 |current_supported_version = 24.10.4 |last_supported_version = |image_too_big = |unsupportedfuncntions = |lan_hardware = Qualcomm Atheros QCA8337 |lan_comment = |wlan_hardware = Qualcomm Atheros QCA9983, Qualcomm Atheros QCA9984 |wlan_comment = single board with miniPCIe connector |usb_sata_comment = |inst_method = See devicepage, see git-commit |inst_comment = |rec_method = U-Boot TFTP + serial recovery |rec_comment = |comment = Provided by Spectrum to subscribers under the model number RAC2V1A. }} {{SCollapse | git • >> | 
ipq806x: add support for Arris TR4400 v2 / RAC2V1A
Hardware specs:
  SoC: Qualcomm IPQ8065 (dual core Cortex-A15)
  RAM: 512 MB DDR3
  Flash: 256 MB NAND, 32 MB NOR
  WiFi: QCA9983 2.4 GHz, QCA9984 5 GHz
  Switch: QCA8337
  Ethernet: 5x 10/100/1000 Mbit/s
  USB: 1x USB 3.0 Type-A
  Buttons: WPS, Reset
  Power: 12 VDC, 2.5 A

Ethernet ports:
  1x WAN: connected to eth2
  4x LAN: connected via the switch to eth0 and eth1
          (eth0 is disabled in OEM firmware)

MAC addresses (OEM and OpenWrt):
  fw_env @ 0x00  d4:ab:82:??:??:?a  LAN (eth1)
  fw_env @ 0x06  d4:ab:82:??:??:?b  WAN (eth2)
  fw_env @ 0x0c  d4:ab:82:??:??:?c  WLAN 2.4 GHz (ath1)
  fw_env @ 0x12  d4:ab:82:??:??:?d  WLAN 5 GHz (ath0)
  fw_env @ 0x18  d4:ab:82:??:??:?e  OEM usage unknown (eth0 in OpenWrt)

  OID d4:ab:82 is registered to:
  ARRIS Group, Inc., 6450 Sequence Drive, San Diego CA 92121, US

More info:
  https://openwrt.org/inbox/toh/arris/tr4400_v2

IMPORTANT:

This port requires moving the 'fw_env' partition prior to first boot to
consolidate 70% of the usable space in flash into a contiguous partition.
'fw_env' contains factory-programmed MAC addresses, SSIDs, and passwords.
Its contents must be copied to 'rootfs_1' prior to booting via initramfs.
Note that the stock 'fw_env' partition  will be wiped during sysupgrade.

A writable 'stock_fw_env' partition pointing to the old, stock location
is included in the port to help rolling back this change if desired.

Installation:

- Requires serial access and a TFTP server.
- Fully boot stock, press ENTER, type in:
mtd erase /dev/mtd21
dd if=/dev/mtd22 bs=128K count=1 | mtd write - /dev/mtd21
umount /config && ubidetach -m 23 && mtd erase /dev/mtd23
- Reboot and interrupt U-Boot by pressing a key, type in:
set mtdids 'nand0=nand0'
set mtdparts 'mtdparts=nand0:155M@0x6500000(mtd_ubi)'
set bootcmd 'ubi part mtd_ubi && ubi read 0x44000000 kernel && bootm'
env save
- Setup TFTP server serving initramfs image as 'recovery.bin', type in:
set ipaddr 192.168.1.1
set serverip 192.168.1.2
tftpboot recovery.bin && bootm
- Use sysupgrade to install squashfs image.
